title: CareLine Loyalty Factor on Installation Jobs Credits
content:
**CareLine loyalty factor — company reschedule credits on Installation Jobs**

A customer holding an active plan of **CareLine Service Plans** has the company reschedule credit on an **Installation Jobs** record multiplied by a loyalty factor. The factor multiplies the credit as a whole.

| Customer's active service holding | Loyalty factor |
|---|---|
| CareLine Premier Plan, CareLine Premier 3-Year Plan or CareLine Estate Plan | 1.25 |
| CareLine Basic Plan or CareLine Plus Plan | 1.1 |
| no active CareLine plan, or only an On-Call Service Account | one |

The plan read is the customer's CareLine plan whose status is active; a plan that is not active does not count.

## Worked examples (hypothetical credit figures)

- A credit figure of 140.00 for a customer with an active CareLine Estate Plan: 140.00 multiplied by 1.25 gives 175.00.
- A credit figure of 140.00 for a customer with an active CareLine Basic Plan: 140.00 multiplied by 1.1 gives 154.00.
- A customer holding only an On-Call Service Account: the credit figure is taken once.
